messages:
mina: Heads-up — deployed qlora-int8-v2 to staging for ja/zh bring-up. Getting odd merges between Han and kana tokens when input uses fullwidth punctuation. Quick repro below.

mina: repro input: `今日は、東京。` (note the fullwidth comma and period)

mina: float32 tokenization (expected):
```
["今日", "は", "、", "東京", "。"]
```

mina: staging int8 pipeline tokenizer output:
```
["今日は", "、東京", "。"]
```

mina: That merge changes alignment and we see downstream translation fragments drop. Not sure how quantization would affect tokenization — suspect packaging issue (tokenizer files replaced?). @raj @julia any ideas?

raj: can repro locally on staging image with the qlora-int8-v2 bundle. grabbing the package sha now. Also seeing this on some mixed Han+Kana inputs, not all.

raj: quick diff: tokenizer.json in the bundle is 28.1KB, expected 31.6KB (from upstream). Hash in manifest: a1b2c3 != expected f7e8d9.

julia: eval-bot just posted the staged-eval run for ja->en. summary from the bot:
```
SACREBLEU (dev-punc-heavy): float32 baseline 31.2 -> int8-staging 25.8 (delta -5.4)
CHRF: 56.1 -> 50.3
Exact-match (named entities): dropped 12% relative
```

eval-bot: Automated eval run 2025-12-02 10:13 UTC

tokenizer-ci: CI test failing: test_tokenization_preserves_punctuation (3/3 failures) after bundle unpack. Error snippet:
```
AssertionError: ['今日は', '、東京', '。'] != ['今日', 'は', '、', '東京', '。']
```

infra-sheriff: I inspected the staging image: the artifact upload step overwrote /opt/models/shared_tokenizers/ja_tokenizer.json with the package-local one during build. The package-local file came from an older checkpoint that used legacy normalizer rules.

raj: that matches my hunch. Legacy normalizer can merge kana with preceding han in some normalization modes. On conversion pipeline we accidentally set `normalizer: composed` -> replaced with `legacy_compat` in the packaging script.

mina: immediate mitigation: I've pinned ja/zh routes on staging to the float32 model and flipped canary off. Rollout PR: #3427. Will keep the int8 build in staging but not routing traffic.

julia: please add a focused regression to the multilingual suite: mix fullwidth/halfwidth punctuation, Han+Kana boundaries, and emoji adjacency. We should run that on any tokenizer/packaging change.

raj: I'll open PR to fix packaging script and add a checksum assert in upload step. Will also add a unit to fail if tokenizer.json size/hash mismatches upstream.

mina: filing internal bug INF-6723 and linking gist with minimal repro: https://gist.github.com/redwood-internal/repro-han-kana-int8 (attached in bug).

julia: :thumbsup: good triage. Once packaging fix lands, let's re-run the staged eval and the targeted regression set.

mina: thanks all — leaving the pinned routing in place until we see green on the fixed bundle. ping me if you need more examples.

infra-sheriff: note — I rolled an alert to infra on artifact checksum failures so future uploads will be blocked until confirmed.

tokenizer-ci: CI will re-run against the fixed bundle once PR lands. I'll post results in the thread.
